business_summary: DTC brand selling vet-formulated, grain-free food for older dogs on a subscription model, focused on joint health and longevity.
stated_claims: Focused on their dog's joints and living longer

relevant_tags.why: Grain-free and vet-formulated health focus aligns with natural pet care.

Largest pet audience in the catalog with repeat-purchase behavior.
Millennials treating dogs as family will respond well to targeted health and longevity claims.
